title: Roostflix, refreshed
summary: A bolder Roostflix look, with smarter playback and My List.

items.title: Roostflix, refreshed
items.text: A full-bleed hero with a big bold title, a Featured row of rounded tiles, and a floating pill menu, plus My List, Start over, and optional trailers on hover.

items.title: Smarter playback
items.text: Skip intro, recap and credits, a Next episode card, chapter marks on the scrubber, speed and sleep timer, J/K/L keys, double-tap to skip 10 seconds, and audio and subtitle language remembered per show.
